about.title: About
about.description:
As a recent computer engineering graduate, I am steadily progressing towards becoming a fully equipped Full Stack developer in .NET technologies and modern web development. I have gained experience in real-world projects using ASP.NET Core, MVC architecture, Entity Framework, and SQL Server. I have practical experience in layered architecture, RESTful API development, user management, and payment integration.

I also develop user-friendly interfaces using frontend technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.js. Through my graduation project, I developed a clone of lastik.com.tr using the MERN stack, gaining the ability to set up a modern e-commerce infrastructure end-to-end.

During my internship, I worked on AI-based projects, developing chatbots using technologies like Dialogflow and ChatGPT API. This has enhanced my ability to integrate different technologies and produce solutions.

As a software developer who can quickly adapt to innovative technologies, is inclined towards teamwork, and has high analytical thinking skills, I aim to specialize in the .NET ecosystem and participate in value-creating projects.

responsibilities.1: • Development and maintenance of modern web applications
responsibilities.2: • Leadership in React and Vue.js based projects
responsibilities.3: • Performance optimization and code quality improvements

internship1.title: Chatbot Developer Intern
internship1.company: Brisa Bridgestone Sabancı Tire Manufacturing and Trading Inc. | July 2023 - September 2023

responsibilities.1: • Had the opportunity to step into the business world for the first time, closely observe a corporate environment, and experience agile and scrum management methods.
responsibilities.2: • Started chatbot development work using tools like Dialogflow, taking important steps in the field of artificial intelligence.
responsibilities.3: • Enhanced and made the existing chatbot for lastik.com.tr more comprehensive and user-friendly.

internship2.title: System Operations Intern
internship2.company: Brisa Bridgestone Sabancı Tire Manufacturing and Trading Inc. | August 2024 - October 2024

responsibilities.1: • Gained valuable experience in cybersecurity; had the opportunity to participate in penetration tests and learn ISO standards for identifying and addressing security vulnerabilities.
responsibilities.2: • Acquired extensive knowledge in hardware and network management; had the chance to closely examine the operation of switches and access points used in the internet network infrastructure of a large corporate factory.
responsibilities.3: • These experiences contributed to strengthening my technical knowledge in both cybersecurity and hardware/network management while helping me understand the importance of teamwork in a large-scale structure.

project1.title: HIZLIPAZAR
project1.subtitle: E-Commerce Platform
project1.description: A modern e-commerce platform. A web application developed with MVC architecture, including essential e-commerce features such as user management, product categorization, cart management, coupon system, balance management, and secure payment integration (credit card, wire transfer/EFT).

project2.title: EVRİM
project2.subtitle: Esenler Urban Transformation Information and Value Calculation Platform
project2.description: To facilitate the urban transformation process in Esenler district, provide informative content to citizens, and enable them to calculate the value of their properties. A modern web platform that offers citizens the opportunity to calculate their home values with current market data, view neighborhood statistics, and make applications.

project3.title: ROBİT
project3.subtitle: Smart Customer Support Chatbot
project3.description: An AI-powered customer service chatbot developed for e-commerce platforms. Offers automatic response system with Dialogflow and ChatGPT integrations, and live support feature via Telegram.

project4.title: KLON
project4.subtitle: Lastik.com.tr clone
project4.description: An e-commerce platform developed as a modern clone of Lastik.com.tr. The original site's core features were redesigned using React, Node.js, and MongoDB technologies.
